aspectRatio.description: Optional. The aspect ratio of the image to generate. Supported aspect ratios: `1:1`, `1:4`, `4:1`, `1:8`, `8:1`, `2:3`, `3:2`, `3:4`, `4:3`, `4:5`, `5:4`, `9:16`, `16:9`, or `21:9`. If not specified, the model will choose a default aspect ratio based on any reference images provided.

imageSize.description: Optional. Specifies the size of generated images. Supported values are `512`, `1K`, `2K`, `4K`. If not specified, the model will use default value `1K`.

responseModalities.description: Optional. The requested modalities of the response.
